cds_jwt_iss
inputs.label: CRD JWT Issuer
inputs.description:
Value of the `iss` claim that must be sent on the Bearer token in the `Authorization`
            header of all requests. Run or re-run the **Client Registration** group to set or
            change this value.

inputs.name: appointment_book_response_approach
inputs.label: Response generation approach for appointment-book
inputs.description:
Determines how Inferno will generate response for appointment-book
              hook invocations.

inputs.name: appointment_book_selected_response_types
inputs.label: Response types to return from appointment-book hook requests
inputs.description:
Select the CRD response types that the simulated Inferno CRD server will [mock](https://github.com/inferno-framework/davinci-crd-test-kit/wiki/Controlling-Simulated-Responses#mocked-responses)
              when responding to hook invocations. If no types are selected, Inferno will mock and return
              a [Coverage Information](https://hl7.org/fhir/us/davinci-crd/2.2.1/en/cards.html#coverage-information-response-type)
              response for this primary hook.

inputs.name: appointment_book_custom_response_template
inputs.label: Custom response template for appointment-book hook requests
inputs.description:
Provide a [custom response template](https://github.com/inferno-framework/davinci-crd-test-kit/wiki/Controlling-Simulated-Responses#tester-directed-custom-responses)
              in JSON form for Inferno to use when responding to hook invocations.

inputs.name: cds_jwt_iss
inputs.label: CRD JWT Issuer
inputs.description:
Value of the `iss` claim that must be sent on the Bearer token in the `Authorization`
            header of all requests. Run or re-run the **Client Registration** group to set or
            change this value.

inputs.name: appointment_book_override_access_token
inputs.label: appointment-book Prefetch Validation Override Bearer Token
inputs.description:
Optionally provide a bearer token to use in place of the one provided in the hook request
              when checking that the prefetched data is equivalent to what can be access via FHIR.
              Use only if the bearer token in the request will not be valid even right after the hook
              request is made. If provided it must have the same scope as the bearer token provided
              in the hook request.

inputs.name: cds_jwk_set
inputs.label: CRD JSON Web Key Set (JWKS)
inputs.description:
The client's registered JWK Set containing it's public key, either
            as a publicly accessible url containing the JWKS, or the raw JWKS.
            Run or re-run the **Client Registration** group to set or
            change this value. Used if the `jku` header is not found in the auth token jwt.
